delete.title: Delete your account
delete.description: Your account and everything you have saved are deleted, and you are logged out on all devices. For 30 days you can have the account restored by emailing kontakt@jobbliggaren.se. After that it is deleted for good and cannot be recovered.
delete.confirmEmailLabel: Enter your email address to confirm
delete.confirmMismatch: Enter your email address as it appears below the field.
delete.mailOff: Email delivery is not enabled right now, so we cannot send a code. If you want to delete your account, email <mail>kontakt@jobbliggaren.se</mail>.
delete.outcomeUnknown: We cannot tell whether the account was deleted. Reload the page.
delete.contactRoute: You can also email <mail>kontakt@jobbliggaren.se</mail> and ask us to delete the account.

reauth.request: To confirm that it is you, we send a six-digit code to {email}.

reauth.burned: You have entered the wrong code three times, so the code can no longer be used. Send a new code and try again.
reauth.resendReceipt: We have sent a new code. Enter the code from the most recent email.
reauth.cooldown: A code was requested for your account a moment ago. Wait a minute and try again.

reauth.unavailable: A code cannot be sent right now. Try again in a few minutes.
reauth.verifyUnavailable: The code cannot be checked right now. Try again in a few minutes.
reauth.codeSpent: The code you entered has been used, so you will need a new code when you try again.
reauth.notLoggedIn: You are no longer logged in. Log in again and start over.
